lesson_text: A path-containment check must test the remainder after the directory prefix (a plain file name, no `..`, no `/`), not `startswith`, and an interpreter-isolation check must also look at the environment the command gets: `-P` keeps the working directory off `sys.path` but still honours `PYTHONPATH`, so assignments before the call, `export`, and `PATH` edits belong in the same allow-list.
